summary: Layout is very close: every data-el is within tolerance and there are no failed taps or contract errors. The main structural problem is that flow f1 fails because the Ask Teacher composer is not a real input. The remaining loss is illustration accuracy (hero character, avatars, Bestie collage) and slightly heavy text weights. All elements are within tolerance and all taps work, so the remaining loss is text weight and 1px offsets. Red text outlines show up on every screen, plus small icon differences. This round should lighten the font weights and adjust the 1px vertical offsets, mainly on s08 and s11, then fix the icon glyphs. The layout is already accurate, with all data-el elements placed and every tap working, so the remaining gains come from visual fidelity. The biggest fixes are the s04 persona label strips, which are still opaque pills, the s14 chip row and game cards, and the text weight and 1px offsets in s15, s13 and s14. Lighter font weights and a 1px downward shift would clear most of the red.. The mock already matches all 18 tagged elements and the layout closely, so the remaining gap is fine visual detail. This round should remove the stray text artifacts, rebuild the Stories card, and tune the text weight and offset plus the card icon placement.
